lines.t: Hey
I lay down my burdens, I let them fade away
The world and its worries, I leave them for this day
Your peace surrounds my spirit, your voice so still and near
I rest within your presence, no shadow left to fear
As I look now to the kings of this world
Let your love be all my song
On this holy Sabbath, Lord
My heart to you belongs
Fill my mind with awe and wonder
At the works your hands have made
Let me dwell in your creation
In the glory of your name
The stars proclaim your promise
Your heavens sing with light
Your whisper calms the oceans
And wakes the dawn of life
I ponder all your mercy
See so vast, so deep, so true
And in my quiet worship
I'm made again in you
As I look not to the cares of this world
Let your love be all my song
On this holy Sabbath, Lord
My heart to you belongs
Fill my mind with awe and wonder
At the works your hands have made
Let me dwell in your creation, in the glory of your name
Just one day to rest in grace, to hear your spirit call
To set aside the endless chase
And give you, Lord, my all
As I look now to the chaos of this world
Let your peace forever reign
On this Sabbath day of mercy
You wash away my pain
I'll dwell upon my Savior's light
My heart in holy flame
Filled with wonder and with awe
At the glory of your name
